material_residuals.trace: The new inner_sids function silently continues on an unreadable IDENTITY or failed binding grep, and returns rc2 only after a matching readable record yields an empty PID; runner_truth treats an unreadable setup.EXIT_RECORD as exit_record=absent with success. session_state re-discovers IDs every time, replaces INNER, and adds unknown for missing IDs only when RUNNER_NOTE still says released=1. Therefore, after a real inner workload was launched, loss of read access to the inner evidence subtree can make both observations disappear; an empty outer session then produces CENSUS=empty and release, even while that inner workload lives. This can also happen after an earlier heartbeat had already observed the inner SID: the prior INNER value is discarded rather than retained.
